colecoes.elegiveisProntas: You have <forte>{total}</forte> free {total, plural, =1 {copy in your inventory that fills an empty slot} other {copies in your inventory that fill empty slots}} in some collection.
colecoes.elegiveisForaDePadrao: Another <forte>{total}</forte> eligible {total, plural, =1 {copy is} other {copies are}} outside the required language only (they need explicit confirmation).
colecoes.ajudaOrganizar: Move groups and collections up and down, move a collection to another group, or create new groups. Deleting a group does not delete its collections.
colecoes.erroOperacao: Could not finish. The list was refreshed.
colecoes.erroRede: Network failure. The list was refreshed.

grupo.ajudaSerie: With a series, the group can create the collections for its sets and bring in the ones you already have.
grupo.erroRede: Network failure while saving the group.
grupo.textoExcluir: The group's collections are not deleted: they go back to “No group”, at the end of the list.

faltantes.descricao: One Set collection for each set of the {serie} series. Uncheck what you don't want and adjust the names.
faltantes.semSets: This series has no sets in the catalog.
faltantes.cartasOficiais: {total, plural, =1 {# official card} other {# official cards}}
faltantes.nomeVazio: Give every checked collection a name.
faltantes.demais: Check at most {maximo} sets at a time.
faltantes.erroRede: No response from the server: it is unknown whether the collections were created. We are reloading the list and the preview; check them before trying again.

existentes.descricao: Set collections that have any set of the series linked to this group. Only the ones in no group come checked.
existentes.nenhuma: No set collection of this series outside this group.
existentes.erroRede: No response from the server: it is unknown whether the collections were moved. We are reloading the list and the preview; check them before trying again.
existentes.demais: Check at most {maximo} collections at a time.

colecoes.grupoExcluido: This group was deleted in another tab.

sugestoes.descricao: Collections you are already close to having. Nothing is created without your click.
sugestoes.erroRede: Network failure. The suggestion list was refreshed.

razao.set: You have {quantidade} of the {total} official cards of the <forte>{rotulo}</forte> set.
razao.especie: You have {quantidade, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} of <forte>{rotulo}</forte>.
razao.tipo: You have {quantidade, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} of the <forte>{rotulo}</forte> type.
razao.ilustrador: You have {quantidade, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} illustrated by <forte>{rotulo}</forte>.
razao.raridade: You have {quantidade, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} of rarity <forte>{rotulo}</forte>.
razao.forma: You have {quantidade, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} in the <forte>{rotulo}</forte> form.
razao.setSemOficial: You have {quantidade} of the {total} cards in the <forte>{rotulo}</forte> set.

sugestoes.confirmarDispensa: This suggestion will not come back. Dismiss it?
sugestoes.cartasAlocadas: {total, plural, =1 {1 card allocated} other {# cards allocated}} to the themed collection.

cadastroBusca.descricao: For a single card: search by name, set or number.
cadastroBusca.erroCriterio: Give at least one criterion: name, set or number.
cadastroBusca.erroSiglaNumero: I could not read that as "set code + number" — e.g. "MEW 151" or "mew151".
cadastroBusca.somada: Added to the copy you already had of {carta} — now there {total, plural, =1 {is} other {are}} {total}.
cadastroBusca.campoSigla: Or straight from the set code printed on the card + number
cadastroBusca.nenhumaCartaAjuda: Check the set code and the number printed on the card. If it really is not in the catalog — it happens with Japanese and promo sets that TCGdex does not catalog — add it by hand.

cartaManual.abrir: Add a card that is not in the catalog
cartaManual.explicacao: For a card TCGdex does not have — such as the <forte>SMH</forte> set (Japanese GX Starter Decks). Copy what is printed on the card. Once added, it behaves like any other card, and the weekly catalog update never removes it.
cartaManual.erroRede: Network failure while adding the card.
cartaManual.ajudaDexId: The Pokédex number is what lets the card fill a slot in a Pokédex collection. Trainer and Energy cards have none — leave it blank.

seletorExpansao.erroCarregar: Failed to load the list of sets.

cadastroSet.descricao: Enter how many of each card you have. Tab moves to the next card. Each card's variant, language and condition start at the batch default set in the bar below; changing one card affects only that card. The variant selector only offers what the card actually has in the catalog.
cadastroSet.erroGrade: Failed to load the set grid.
cadastroSet.erroRede: Network failure while saving the batch.
cadastroSet.loteComFusao: {inseridas, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}} saved and {fundidas} added to copies of {set} you already had.
cadastroSet.loteGravado: {inseridas, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}} saved from {set}.
cadastroSet.catalogoEn: <forte>Catalog: EN</forte> — this set has no card-by-card data in Portuguese upstream. Each card's identity uses the English entry; the language below is the one of YOUR physical copy (e.g. pick <codigo>pt</codigo> if it is the Brazilian edition).
cadastroSet.catalogoMisto: {total, plural, one {# card in this set has no Portuguese entry upstream yet and uses the English one} other {# cards in this set have no Portuguese entry upstream yet and use the English one}}. The language below is still the one of YOUR physical copy.
cadastroSet.filtrarNumero: Filter by number (single card — leading zeros tolerated)
cadastroSet.nenhumaCarta: No card with that number in this set.

comum.rotuloAlocacao: {total, plural, =0 {No free copy of yours fits this slot.} =1 {1 free copy of yours fits this slot.} other {# free copies of yours fit this slot.}}
comum.rotuloMelhoria: {total, plural, =0 {No free copy of yours is better than this one.} =1 {1 free copy of yours is better than the one allocated here.} other {# free copies of yours are better than the one allocated here.}}

seloOrigem.catalogo-en: Photo of the English card — the catalog has no photo of the Portuguese version.
seloOrigem.catalogo-pt: Photo of the Portuguese card — the catalog has no photo of the English version.
seloOrigem.mypcards: Photo from mypcards, not from the official TCGdex catalog.

colecaoNova.descricao: Slots are created together with the collection. Filling each slot is always manual, done after creation — the system never fills a slot on its own.
colecaoNova.campoIdiomaCatalogo: Preferred catalog language (each card uses its entry in this language and falls back to the other one; not the physical language of your copies)
colecaoNova.semPt: This set has no card-by-card data in pt upstream — the identity of the cards uses the en entry.
colecaoNova.incluirSecretas: Include secrets ({total} cards in total, instead of {oficiais} official)
colecaoNova.ajudaIdiomaExigido: The physical language of the copy. A copy in another language can still be allocated — it comes flagged as off-standard and needs explicit confirmation.
colecaoNova.erroRede: Network failure while creating the collection.
colecaoNova.ajudaVariosSets: The collection joins the chosen sets, in the order of the list. Once created, single cards can be added and removed.
colecaoNova.setDaSugestaoNaoEncontrado: The suggested set is not in the catalog (pt or en). Pick the expansion below.
colecaoNova.erroSugestao: Could not load the suggested set.

colecoesFalta.resumo: {vagas, plural, =1 {# empty slot} other {# empty slots}} across {colecoes, plural, =1 {# collection} other {# collections}}.
colecoesFalta.filtroAlocaveis: Show only what I can allocate now ({total}) — a free copy of yours fits the slot
colecoesFalta.nadaFalta: Nothing missing — every Pokédex and Set collection is complete (or none has been created yet).
colecoesFalta.copiasSuas: {total, plural, =1 {# copy of yours} other {# copies of yours}}
colecoesFalta.erroCarregar: Failed to load the missing cards.

visaoGeral.descricao: Your collection at a glance. Click a collection to open it, or any statistic to open the inventory already filtered.
visaoGeral.repetidasDescricao: What is left over for trading — total, allocated and free per card →
visaoGeral.joiasDescricao: The cards worth the most in your collection; those without a looked-up price follow rarity.
visaoGeral.quaseLaDescricao: The divisions closest to done, with the first cards still missing.
visaoGeral.faltam: {total, plural, =1 {1 to go} other {# to go}}
visaoGeral.estatisticasDescricao: How the inventory is spread out. Click any breakdown to open the inventory already filtered.

repetidas.descricao: {total, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} with 2 or more units. Sorted by free units, descending.
repetidas.soLivres: Only with free units (what you can trade)
repetidas.idiomaTitulo: {quantidade, plural, =1 {# unit} other {# units}} in {idioma}, {livres} free
repetidas.vazio: No duplicate cards (2+ units) in the inventory.
repetidas.vazioSoLivres: No duplicate card with free units right now.

imagemLocal.gatilhoTrocarTitulo: Replace or remove the image of {carta}
imagemLocal.gatilhoAdicionarTitulo: No image in the catalog — add a photo of {carta}
imagemLocal.erroRedeRemover: Network failure while removing the image.
imagemLocal.erroRedeMapear: Network failure while mapping the set.
imagemLocal.setMapeadoComFila: Set mapped. Downloading {total, plural, =1 {# photo} other {# photos}} in the background — reload in a moment.
imagemLocal.setMapeadoSemFila: Set mapped. No card in this set was missing a photo.
imagemLocal.erroColeMypcards: Paste the address of an image of the set on mypcards.
imagemLocal.erroColeLink: Paste the link to the image.
imagemLocal.erroRedeEnviar: Network failure while uploading the image.
imagemLocal.explicacaoTrocar: This card uses an image you uploaded. Upload another one to replace it, or remove it to fall back to what the catalog offers.
imagemLocal.explicacaoAdicionar: This card has no image in the catalog. Upload a file or paste a link — the image is kept in the system and applies to every copy of this card.
imagemLocal.campoMypcards: Link to any image of set {set} on mypcards
imagemLocal.ajudaMypcards: Open the set on mypcards, right-click a card and copy the image address. One link resolves the whole set: the system reads the set id and downloads every photo missing from it.
imagemLocal.ajudaArquivo: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 8 MB.
imagemLocal.ajudaLink: The server downloads and keeps the file — not just the link.

inventario.descricao: {total, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}} in total.
inventario.exportarLigaTitulo: ZIP with the inventory in LigaPokemon's import format, split into files of up to 995 cards.
inventario.filtroImagemTitulo: Cards with no local image (uploaded, from a link or from mypcards) and no usable image in the catalog — missing, or checked and not found on the CDN. Some may show a photo anyway: the same card's in the other language, a CDN file the check confirmed or, for Japanese, a direct try on the CDN.
inventario.confirmarRemoverAlocada: It is allocated to a slot, which will be left empty.
inventario.confirmarDesalocar: Remove {carta} from {colecao} (slot #{vaga})? The copy goes back to being free in the inventory.
inventario.selecionadas: {total, plural, =1 {# copy selected.} other {# copies selected.}}
inventario.vazio: No copy found with these filters.
inventario.loteDividido: The batch was split: 1 unit went to the collection, the rest stays free in the inventory.
inventario.modalAlocarExplicacao: The system suggests eligible collections/slots; the choice is always yours.
inventario.semDestinos: No collection or slot is eligible for this copy.
inventario.erroMassa: Failed to apply the bulk edit.
inventario.erroRedeMassa: Network failure while applying the bulk edit.
inventario.massaAtualizadas: {total, plural, =1 {# copy updated.} other {# copies updated.}}
inventario.massaTitulo: Edit {total, plural, =1 {# selected copy} other {# selected copies}}
inventario.massaExplicacao: Check only the fields you want to change. The allocation of the copies is not touched by this edit.
inventario.semVarianteComum: the selection mixes cards with no variant in common in the catalog — edit the variant copy by copy
inventario.massaConfirma: Confirm changing {total, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}}?
inventario.massaAplicar: Apply to {total, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}}

colecaoDetalhe.confirmarExcluir: Delete the collection "{nome}"? The inventory copies are not deleted — they just become free again.
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarDesalocar: Remove {alvo} from its slot? The copy goes back to the inventory as free.
colecaoDetalhe.avisoCatalogoIncompleto: The local catalog only knows {materializadas} of the {esperadas} cards of this set upstream — {faltantes} are missing. The collection does not pretend to be complete: the progress above reflects only what the local catalog has today.
colecaoDetalhe.avisoSemNumeracaoOficial: This set has no separate official numbering upstream (it is a promo collection). This collection's universe uses the {total} known cards of the whole set instead of the official count.
colecaoDetalhe.filtroSoVazias: Show empty slots only ({total}) — what this collection is missing
colecaoDetalhe.filtroSoMelhorias: Show slots with an upgrade only ({total}) — you own a better copy than the allocated one
colecaoDetalhe.vazioSoVazias: Nothing missing — every slot is filled.
colecaoDetalhe.vazioSoMelhorias: No slot with an upgrade available.
colecaoDetalhe.incluirSecretas: Include secrets (numbering beyond the official one)
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarDesligarSecretas: Turning secrets off removes the secret slots that are still empty. If any is already filled, the operation is refused. Continue?
colecaoDetalhe.legendaEscopo: Scope — add or remove a region without affecting the slots that already exist
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarRemoverRegiao: Remove {regiao} from the scope? It is only allowed if no slot of this region is filled — otherwise the operation is refused and says how many there are.
colecaoDetalhe.erroRedeEscopo: Network failure while changing the scope.
colecaoDetalhe.vagasAdicionadas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot added} other {# slots added}}
colecaoDetalhe.vagasRemovidas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot removed} other {# slots removed}}
colecaoDetalhe.escopoInalterado: The scope was already like that.
colecaoDetalhe.campoAdicionarLivre: Add a free copy from the inventory
colecaoDetalhe.erroBuscarLivres: Failed to search for free copies.
colecaoDetalhe.loteDivididoColecao: The batch was split: 1 unit went to the collection, the rest stays free in the inventory.
colecaoDetalhe.loteDivididoVaga: The batch was split: 1 unit went to the slot, the rest stays free in the inventory.
colecaoDetalhe.modalAlocarExplicacao: The system suggests candidates; the choice is always yours.
colecaoDetalhe.semCandidatos: No free copy in the inventory for this slot.
colecaoDetalhe.modalMelhoriaExplicacao: These free copies of yours are better than the allocated one. The system suggests and ranks; the swap is always yours.
colecaoDetalhe.trocaFeita: Slot #{vaga}: {entrou} ({setEntrou}) took the place of {saiu} ({setSaiu}), which went back to the inventory as free.
colecaoDetalhe.erroRedeDescartar: Network failure while dismissing the suggestion.
colecaoDetalhe.descartarTitulo: Hides this suggestion, for this slot only. A better copy that shows up later will flag it again.
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarTirarVazia: Remove {alvo} from the collection? The card leaves the missing list.
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarTirarPreenchida: Remove {alvo} from the collection? The copy allocated to this slot becomes free in the inventory again — it is not deleted.
colecaoDetalhe.cartaTiradaCopiaLivre: {alvo} left the collection; the copy is free in the inventory again.
colecaoDetalhe.erroTirar: Could not remove the card from the collection.
colecaoDetalhe.avisoSemNumeracaoOficialDoSet: {sets} has no separate official numbering upstream; in this collection it comes in with its {total} known cards, with no secrets distinction.
colecaoDetalhe.temaCartasAlocadas: {total, plural, =1 {1 card allocated} other {# cards allocated}} to this theme.

opcoesCompra.descricaoSet: LigaPokemon prices for the cards missing from this set. Each slot has a single card — the decision to buy is yours.
opcoesCompra.descricaoPokedex: LigaPokemon prices for the empty slots of this Pokédex. The system filters and ranks; the choice is yours.
opcoesCompra.erroIniciar: Could not start the price scan.
opcoesCompra.erroMarcacao: The selection was not saved. Reload the page.
opcoesCompra.erroCopiar: Could not copy automatically — select the text above and copy it by hand.
opcoesCompra.todasJaMarcadas: Every slot with an offer already has a card selected.
opcoesCompra.ritmoEnv: One request every {intervalo}, set in LIGA_INTERVALO_SEGUNDOS.
opcoesCompra.ritmoRobots: One request every {intervalo}, which is the Crawl-delay in their robots.txt.
opcoesCompra.ritmoConservador: One request every {intervalo}: their robots.txt could not be read, and without a reading the conservative value applies.
opcoesCompra.varreduraIniciada: Price scan started: {vagas, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}}, estimated {estimativa} (expected to finish {previsao}).
opcoesCompra.varreduraPuladas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} already had a recent lookup and {total, plural, =1 {was} other {were}} skipped.
opcoesCompra.varreduraPodeSair: You can leave this screen — the result is saved, and firing it again picks up where it stopped.
opcoesCompra.reconsultarTudo: Scan everything again (ignores what was already looked up)
opcoesCompra.explicacaoFrescor: A slot looked up in the last {horas} hours is skipped, so firing it again picks up where it stopped. Reverse and holo do not come in here: the variant belongs to the offer, not to the card — it shows up when you open a specific card.
opcoesCompra.explicacaoSet: In a set, the search is by card name and only the right edition and number count: a reprint in another edition does not fill the slot.
opcoesCompra.resumoVarredura: {vagas, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} looked up · {requisicoes, plural, =1 {# request} other {# requests}}
opcoesCompra.faltamVagas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot left} other {# slots left}}
opcoesCompra.telaSeAtualiza: the screen refreshes on its own; you can leave and come back
opcoesCompra.vagasSemOferta: {total, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} with no offer
opcoesCompra.vagasSemOpcao: {total, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} with no option
opcoesCompra.varreduraInterrompida: The price scan stopped before the end: {erro} What was already looked up is still below.
opcoesCompra.marcarMelhor: Select the best of each slot
opcoesCompra.marcarMelhorAjuda: Selects the first option of the slots that still have no card chosen — the best one by the sort order you picked.
opcoesCompra.cartasNaLista: {total, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} on the list · {valor}
opcoesCompra.semPrecoTitulo: Cards that did not show up in the last price scan. They stay on the list with the price from last time — or with no price, when there never was one.
opcoesCompra.guardadasTitulo: Cards you chose whose slot is already filled. They leave the string but are kept — if the copy leaves the slot, they come back.
opcoesCompra.guardadas: {total, plural, =1 {# already added} other {# already added}}, off the list
opcoesCompra.compraPorLista: Buy by List — text to paste
opcoesCompra.abaResumo: In this tab: {total, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} · {valor}.
opcoesCompra.limitePorAba: Their Buy by List takes up to {limite} cards per search: paste one tab at a time.
opcoesCompra.multiplasAviso: More than one card selected for the same Pokémon:
opcoesCompra.multiplasTitulo: More than one card selected in this slot. It is allowed, but each line in the string is one card bought.
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueOpcaoTitulo: Liga returned this card as out of stock. It stays here because it is selected.
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueTitulo: Cards out of stock on Liga ({total} recorded)
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueAjuda: Paste here the “Cards sem estoque” notice that their Buy by List returns. Those cards stop being offered for 30 days, in every collection, and their selections on this list are cleared. Before saving, you see what will happen.
opcoesCompra.semEstoquePlaceholder:
Cards sem estoque:
Remover aviso
1 Blastoise (14/100) - [Qualidade = NM]
opcoesCompra.semEstoquePrevia: {cartas, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} recognized · {desmarcadas, plural, =1 {# selection} other {# selections}} on this list will be cleared
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueSoRegistra: not selected on this list, recorded only
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueNaoEntendidas: {total, plural, =1 {# line} other {# lines}} not recognized — left out:
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueGravado: {registradas, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} recorded as out of stock · {desmarcadas, plural, =1 {# selection} other {# selections}} cleared.
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueNadaReconhecido: No card recognized in the pasted text.
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueErroCarregar: Could not load the out-of-stock cards.
opcoesCompra.semEstoqueErroRemover: Could not offer this card again.
opcoesCompra.comoColar: Paste it into their Buy by List. Under “Adicionar Detalhes”, Quality: <forte>NM</forte>. Grouping by store is done by Liga, under “Otimizar minha Lista de Compras”.
opcoesCompra.listaGuardada: The list is kept: it survives a new price scan (which updates the prices instead of wiping the shortlist) and shrinks on its own as you add the cards.
opcoesCompra.totalEhPiso: The {valor} is the lowest price of each card in any condition — a floor for checking, not a budget in NM.
opcoesCompra.esconderSemOferta: Hide slots with no offer at all
opcoesCompra.esconderSemOpcao: Hide slots with no option at all
opcoesCompra.vazioComLista: Your shopping list is above, ready to paste. Fire a search whenever you want to refresh the prices.
opcoesCompra.vazioSemVarredura: No price scan yet. Pick the parameters above and fire the first search.
opcoesCompra.semOfertaSet: No offer in stock for this card within the filters.
opcoesCompra.semOpcaoPokedex: No card in stock within the cap.
opcoesCompra.foraDoCatalogoTitulo: Not in our catalog: if you buy it, adding it afterwards is manual
opcoesCompra.descricaoSetCardmarket: The cards this set is missing, from our catalog, with the Cardmarket reference value. The decision to buy is yours; the real price shows on Liga once you paste the list.
opcoesCompra.descricaoPokedexCardmarket: The cards from our catalog that fit each empty slot, with the Cardmarket reference value. The system filters and sorts; the choice is yours.
opcoesCompra.rebuscarTudo: Also look up again what already has a price
opcoesCompra.explicacaoCardmarket: LigaPokemon's search is blocked for the system, so the options come from our catalog. The price is the Cardmarket reference value converted at the day's PTAX rate: it sits close to Liga's lowest price, but it is not what you will pay — the real price shows in their Buy by List, after you paste. Each price is valid for {dias} days; looking up again skips what is still valid.
opcoesCompra.coberturaPrecos: {comPreco} of {cartas} card(s) priced · {aBuscar} to look up
opcoesCompra.buscaPuladas: {total} card(s) with a recent price were skipped.
opcoesCompra.buscaComErro: The price lookup ended with an error: {erro} What was already looked up is still below.
opcoesCompra.semPrecoNaoBuscado: Price not looked up yet. Use “Look up prices (Cardmarket)”.
opcoesCompra.semPrecoNoCardmarket: Cardmarket has no price for this card (looked up on {data}).
opcoesCompra.dicaPrecoCardmarket: {eur} × PTAX {cotacao} of {data}. International reference, close to Liga's lowest price — not a Brazilian market price.
opcoesCompra.dicaCriterioMedia30: The trend ({tendencia}) was above 3× the 30-day average; the 30-day average is used.
opcoesCompra.dicaCriterioMedia: Cardmarket has no trend for this card; the average is used.
opcoesCompra.semPrecoTituloCardmarket: Cards with no Cardmarket value: price not looked up yet, no price there, or not in our catalog. They are in the list, not in the total.
opcoesCompra.totalEhReferencia: The {valor} add up the Cardmarket reference value converted at PTAX: close to Liga's lowest price, not a budget. The real price shows in their Buy by List.
opcoesCompra.listaGuardadaCardmarket: The list is kept, and it shrinks on its own as you register the cards.
opcoesCompra.marcarMelhorAjudaCardmarket: Marks the first priced option of each slot with no card chosen yet — the best by the sort you picked, within the ceiling.
opcoesCompra.nadaComPrecoParaMarcar: No slot without a choice has a priced card within the ceiling. Look up the prices first.
opcoesCompra.vazioSemCandidatas: No empty slot of this collection has a card in our catalog.
opcoesCompra.semCandidataPokedex: No card of this species in the catalog within the ceiling.
opcoesCompra.semCandidataSet: This slot's card is not in our catalog.
opcoesCompra.escolhaAvulsaTitulo: Chosen earlier, in a Liga scan, and not among the catalog cards for this slot. Unmark it if you no longer want it.

precos.descricao: What the cards you own, except plain commons and uncommons are worth on LigaPokemon. A snapshot from the moment of the lookup, always in Brazilian reais.
precos.erroIniciar: Failed to start the price lookup.
precos.iniciada: Lookup started: {cartas} cards, about {estimativa}, expected to finish {previsao}.
precos.puladas: {total} already looked up in the last {horas} h were skipped.
precos.podeSair: You can leave this screen; the lookup keeps running on the server.
precos.ritmoEnv: One request every {intervalo}, set in LIGA_INTERVALO_SEGUNDOS on this installation.
precos.ritmoRobots: One request every {intervalo}, which is the Crawl-delay in their robots.txt.
precos.ritmoConservador: One request every {intervalo}: their robots.txt could not be read, and without a reading the conservative value applies.
precos.explicacaoRitmo: The public default pace follows the Crawl-delay in LigaPokemon's robots.txt (currently about 6 minutes per request); this installation overrides it, by its installer's choice. Cards looked up in the last {horas} h are skipped, and a search by name may take more than one request per card.
precos.telaSeAtualiza: The screen refreshes by itself while the lookup runs.
precos.resumo: {comPreco} of {selecionadas} cards priced · sum of average prices {soma}
precos.naoEncontradaTitulo: The card did not show up in the first pages of the name search on Liga.
precos.vazio: No prices stored. Press the button to look up the special cards.

cardmarket.descricao: What the cards you own, except plain commons and uncommons, are worth by an international reference: the Cardmarket price trend, delivered by TCGdex and converted to Brazilian reais at the Central Bank of Brazil's PTAX closing rate. It is not a Brazilian market price: compare it with LigaPokemon's lowest price, not with its average.
cardmarket.cotacaoUsada: Exchange rate used: {euro} = {real} (Central Bank of Brazil PTAX of {data})
cardmarket.explicacaoRitmo: One card at a time, looked up on TCGdex and never in parallel; the euro rate is fetched once, at the start. Cards looked up in the last {horas} h are skipped.
cardmarket.resumo: {comPreco} of {selecionadas} cards priced · sum of trend prices {soma}
cardmarket.foilExplicacao: TCGdex only has a Cardmarket price for the foil version of this card; all three values are for that version.
cardmarket.semPrecoExplicacao: TCGdex has no Cardmarket price for this card.
cardmarket.criterioMedia30Explicacao: The Cardmarket trend ({tendencia}) is more than {limite}× the average of the last 30 days ({media30}), so the 30-day average is used.
cardmarket.criterioMediaExplicacao: Cardmarket has no trend for this card, so its average price is used.

grafico.aviso: The total also goes up when cards enter the sum (a new round may price more cards), so buying or pricing more cards is not appreciation. Compare the average price per card and look at how many cards each point has.
grafico.umPonto: First point: {total} across {cartas} cards, on {data}. The line appears from the second round.
grafico.rotuloGrafico: Chart of the total value of priced cards, with {pontos} point(s). The full data is in the table below.
grafico.toqueParaVer: Tap a point on the chart to see its value. Tap outside to release it.

cardmarket.titulo: Sum of trend prices over the rounds
cardmarket.aviso: The sum also goes up when cards enter it (a new round may price more cards), so buying or pricing more cards is not appreciation. It also follows the exchange rate: each price is converted at the PTAX of the day it was looked up. Compare the average trend per card and look at how many cards each point has. LigaPokemon's points are kept apart and do not enter here.
cardmarket.rotuloGrafico: Chart of the sum of Cardmarket trend prices in reais, with {pontos} point(s). The full data is in the table below.
cardmarket.ponto: {data}: sum of trends {total}, {media} per card, {cartas} priced cards

rodadas.explicacao: Deleting a lookup removes its record and its point on the chart. The prices it brought in remain. Interrupted lookups are left out of the chart.
rodadas.confirmarExcluir: Delete the lookup from {data}? The record and the chart point go away; the prices it brought in stay.

v2Laboratorio.intro: The v2 shell and primitives in every state. It is for checking the next packages: screenshots at the contract widths, Esc, focus, scroll lock and light mode. In a production build this page answers 404.
v2Laboratorio.campoDica: How many identical copies you have.
v2Laboratorio.areaTextoExemplo: Where it is, who it came from…
v2Laboratorio.painelTexto: Translucent background and edge, no blur: it can repeat across a whole screen.
v2Laboratorio.avisoTexto: The text says what it is; the colour only reinforces it.
v2Laboratorio.camadasTexto: Esc closes only the top layer; Tab stays inside the top dialog; the page does not scroll underneath at any width.
v2Laboratorio.simplesDescricao: On a phone it is a sheet that rises from the bottom, with its actions always in view.
v2Laboratorio.longoTexto: the body scrolls inside the dialog, and the page behind stays still.
v2Laboratorio.pilhaDescricao: Open another on top and press Esc: only the top one closes.
v2Laboratorio.porCimaTexto: This layer sits one level above the dialog. Esc closes only this one.
v2Laboratorio.confirmarDescricao: The copies stay in the inventory. This cannot be undone.
v2Laboratorio.focoTexto: Open from an origin and close with Esc: focus goes back to it. Remove the origin and close: it left the DOM, and focus goes to the main content.
v2Laboratorio.origemTexto: Close with Esc or remove the origin.
v2Laboratorio.efeitosTexto: The switch here is local to the laboratory; the real logic (heuristic, stored preference) belongs to the Card package. Light mode stops the ambient light, the iris and the glass sheen.
v2Laboratorio.refracaoEstado: secure context: {seguro} · Chromium: {chromium} · light mode: {leve} → refraction: {ligada}
v2Laboratorio.rolagemTexto: The window scrolls at every width; the rail and the tab bar float above it.

v2Colecoes.ajudaOrganizar: Groups, order, batch actions, suggestions and the thematic collection are still done in the v1: the button above opens its list.
v2Colecoes.elegiveisProntas: You have <forte>{total}</forte> free {total, plural, =1 {copy in your inventory that fills an empty slot} other {copies in your inventory that fill empty slots}} in some collection.
v2Colecoes.elegiveisForaDePadrao: Another <forte>{total}</forte> eligible {total, plural, =1 {copy is outside the required language only (it needs} other {copies are outside the required language only (they need}} explicit confirmation).
v2Colecoes.erroCarregarTexto: The list did not come from the server. Nothing was changed.
v2Colecoes.vazioTexto: A collection is a Pokédex, a set or a list of your own. Slots are born empty, and you are the one who fills them.

formulario.descricao: Slots are created together with the collection. Filling each slot is always manual, done after creation: the system never fills a slot on its own.
formulario.escopoNacionalAjuda: Every species, from no. 1 to no. 1025.
formulario.ajudaVariosSets: The collection joins the chosen sets, in the order of the list. Once created, single cards can be added and removed.
formulario.ajudaIdiomaCatalogo: Each card uses its entry in this language and falls back to the other one. It is not the physical language of your copies.
formulario.semPt: This set has no card-by-card data in pt upstream: the identity of the cards uses the en entry.
formulario.incluirSecretas: Include secrets ({total} cards in total, instead of {oficiais} official)
formulario.ajudaIdiomaExigido: The physical language of the copy. A copy in another language can still be allocated: it comes flagged as off-standard and needs explicit confirmation.
formulario.erroRede: Network failure while creating the collection.
formulario.setDaSugestaoNaoEncontrado: The suggested set is not in the catalog (pt or en). Pick the set below.
formulario.erroSugestao: Could not load the suggested set.

seletor.erroCarregar: Failed to load the list of sets.

formulario.catalogoJaponesAutomatico: Every set in this collection is from the Japanese catalog: it uses the Japanese entries, with no language to pick.
formulario.misturaTitulo: Japanese cannot be mixed with pt/en
formulario.misturaTexto: The recipe has sets from the Japanese catalog and from the Western one (pt/en). Japanese never fills in for pt/en, nor the other way round: neo1 to neo4, for example, share a code in English and Japanese but are different cards. Keep only one side in the recipe; to have both, create two collections.

v2Detalhe.semCopias: You have no copy of this card.
v2Detalhe.desalocarExplica: Deallocating takes the copy out of the slot and returns it to the inventory as free. The copy is never deleted.
v2Detalhe.foraDoPadrao: Out of pattern: {idioma}, the collection requires {exigido}

desatualizada.titulo: This slot changed in another tab

melhoria.temMelhor: {total, plural, one {You have a better free copy} other {You have # better free copies}}
melhoria.explica: Swapping puts the chosen copy in the slot and returns the current one to the inventory as free, in a single operation: if it fails, the slot stays as it is. Nothing is swapped without your click.
melhoria.descartarExplica: Dismissing silences the suggestion of this copy in this slot, and only that one: if another better copy enters the inventory, the slot flags it again. Nothing is deleted.

vazia.lote: A row with more than one unit is split when allocated: one unit goes to the slot, the rest stays free.

compra.nenhuma: This slot is not on the buy list.

estatisticas.descricao: How the inventory is distributed. Tap a slice to open the inventory already filtered.
estatisticas.repetidasDescricao: What is left over to trade: total, allocated and free per card.

v2Repetidas.descricao: {total, plural, =0 {No cards} =1 {1 card} other {# cards}} with 2 or more units. Sorted by free units, most first.
v2Repetidas.vazio: No duplicate cards (2 or more units) in the inventory.
v2Repetidas.vazioSoLivres: No duplicate card with free units right now.
v2Repetidas.erroCarregarTexto: The read failed. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.

v2Inicio.erroCarregar: The home page could not be loaded
v2Inicio.erroCarregarTexto: Reading the database failed. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.

lead.cadastradas: {cartas, plural, =1 {1 card} other {# cards}} entered the inventory in the last 7 days.
lead.nenhumaCadastrada: No card entered the inventory in the last 7 days.
lead.quaseLa: {divisao} is {faltam, plural, =1 {1 slot} other {# slots}} away from complete.
lead.vazio: Enter your first cards and build a collection: what each one is missing shows up here.

vitrine.vazioTitulo: No cards in the inventory yet
vitrine.vazioTexto: Start with entry by set, marking the cards of an expansion all at once, or search for a card by name.

cadastradas.contagem: {unidades, plural, =1 {1 unit} other {# units}} · {cartas, plural, =1 {1 card} other {# cards}}
cadastradas.mais: {total, plural, =1 {+1 copy in the inventory} other {+# copies in the inventory}}
cadastradas.vazio: No card entered the inventory in the last 7 days.
cadastradas.nota: Counts the day each copy entered the inventory, in São Paulo time. Units added on entry to a copy that already existed keep that copy's date, and a copy split off a lot before 2026-11-23 carries the date of the split.

dex.recebidos: {total, plural, =1 {1 received to put away} other {# received to put away}}
dex.levarAoHome: {total, plural, =1 {1 Pokémon to take to HOME} other {# Pokémon to take to HOME}}
dex.maisTarefas: {total, plural, =1 {+1 open task} other {+# open tasks}}
dex.maisPlanos: {total, plural, =1 {+1 active plan} other {+# active plans}}

v2Inventario.contagem: {total, plural, =0 {No copies} one {# copy} other {# copies}}
v2Inventario.exportarLigaExplica: The CSV has the whole inventory. The LigaPokemon export downloads a ZIP in the site's import format, in files of up to 995 cards. Neither follows the filters.
v2Inventario.erroRede: No answer from the server. Check the connection and try again.
v2Inventario.filtrosInvalidos: A filter in the address has a value the inventory does not know. Clear the filters to see the list.
v2Inventario.vazio: No copies in the inventory yet.

filtros.imagemDica: No photo of your own and no usable catalog photo. Some still show a photo from another source.

selecao.total: {total, plural, one {# copy selected} other {# copies selected}}

remover.alocada: It is in {colecao}: the slot becomes empty.
remover.jaRemovida: This copy no longer existed (it may have been removed in another tab). The list was read again.

massa.explica: Tick only what you want to change; the rest stays as it is. No allocation is touched.
massa.localizacaoDica: Left blank, it clears the copies' location.
massa.idiomaDica: The language of the card in your hand, not of the catalog entry.
massa.varianteDica: Only the variants every card in the selection has in the catalog.
massa.semVarianteComum: The selection mixes cards with no variant in common in the catalog: change the variant copy by copy, in the detail.
massa.aplicar: {total, plural, one {Apply to # copy} other {Apply to # copies}}
massa.confirmarAlocacao: All or nothing: if one copy cannot change, none does.
massa.feito: {total, plural, one {# copy updated.} other {# copies updated.}}
massa.selecaoMudou: The selection changed while the question was open (the list was read again). Check the copies and apply again.

v2Colecao.erroCarregarTexto: The grid did not come back from the server. Nothing was changed.
v2Colecao.erroReler: Could not reread the collection after the last change: what is on screen may be out of date.
v2Colecao.semVagasTexto: This collection's scope or recipe has no slots in the local catalog.
v2Colecao.vazioCustomizadaTexto: In a custom collection a slot is born when you add a free copy from the inventory.

cabecalho.vazias: {total, plural, =1 {1 empty slot} other {# empty slots}}
cabecalho.catalogoIncompletoTexto: The local catalog only knows {materializadas} of the {esperadas} cards of this set upstream — {faltantes} missing. The progress reflects only what the local catalog has today.
cabecalho.semNumeracaoTexto: This set has no separate official numbering upstream. The collection uses all {total} known cards of the set.
cabecalho.semNumeracaoDoSet: {sets} has no separate official numbering upstream; in this collection it counts all {total} known cards, with no secrets split.

fichario.fimTexto: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot} other {# slots}} in this collection

inteiro.resumoCustomizada: {total, plural, =1 {1 card} other {# cards}}, in the order they came in

bolso.livres: {total, plural, =1 {1 free copy fits} other {# free copies fit}}

tirar.cheia: The copy allocated to this slot becomes free in the inventory again — it is not deleted.
tirar.vazia: The card leaves the missing list. You can add it again later.
tirar.erro: Could not remove the card from the collection.
tirar.erroRede: No answer from the server. The collection was reread: check it before trying again.
tirar.feitoCopiaLivre: {alvo} left the collection; the copy is free in the inventory again.

tema.alocadas: {total, plural, =1 {1 card allocated} other {# cards allocated}} to this theme.

upgrades.nenhumTexto: Every slot holds the best free copy you have.
upgrades.explica: You have free copies better than the ones in these slots. The system flags them; the swap is always yours, in the slot's detail, and sends today's copy back to the inventory.
upgrades.erroCandidatas: Could not read the candidates now; each slot's detail shows them.
upgrades.outras: {total, plural, =1 {1 more candidate} other {# more candidates}}

ajustes.idiomaExigidoDica: The language of the physical card. A copy in another language can still go in, with a confirmation.
ajustes.erroRede: No answer from the server. Check the collection before trying again.
ajustes.secretasRotulo: Include secrets (numbering beyond the official count)
ajustes.secretasDesligarTexto: The secret slots leave the collection. If any is already filled, nothing changes: the server refuses and says how many are filled.
ajustes.escopoExplica: Turn regions on or off. The slots of the other regions do not change.
ajustes.escopoVazio: A Pokédex needs at least one region.
ajustes.regiaoTirarTexto: This region's slots leave the collection, and their buy choices are kept. If any is already filled, nothing changes: the server refuses and says how many.
ajustes.vagasAdicionadas: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot added} other {# slots added}}
ajustes.vagasRemovidas: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot removed} other {# slots removed}}
ajustes.escopoInalterado: The scope was already like that.
ajustes.excluirExplica: Inventory copies are never deleted: they only become free again.
ajustes.excluirTexto: The collection and its slots go away. Inventory copies are not deleted — they become free again.

incluir.explica: Any card in the catalog, from any set. It comes in as an empty slot; allocating a copy still happens in the slot.

adicionar.explica: Free copies from your inventory. A lot with more than one unit is split: only one goes in.
adicionar.foraTexto: The collection requires {exigido} and this copy is {idioma}. It goes in marked as out of pattern.
adicionar.loteDividido: The lot was split: 1 unit went in, the rest stays free in the inventory.
adicionar.erroRede: No answer from the server: there is no telling whether the copy went in. The list was reread.

aba.nadaTexto: Every slot of this collection is filled.
aba.erro: Could not read the buy list.
aba.erroTexto: The empty slots are still here; marking to buy comes back once the read works.
aba.instrucaoSet: Tap a card to put it on the buy list, and again to take it off. Drag sideways across several to mark them all at once.
aba.instrucaoPokedex: Tap a slot to see the cards that fit it and choose.
aba.instrucaoLivre: A slot with a free copy of yours opens the detail, to allocate it.
aba.rotuloLista: {total, plural, =1 {1 empty slot} other {# empty slots}}
aba.arrastoMarcou: {total, plural, =1 {1 card went} other {# cards went}} on the list.
aba.arrastoTirou: {total, plural, =1 {1 card came} other {# cards came}} off the list.

fonte.ligaTexto: LigaPokemon has blocked automated lookups since 2026-11-11, and the system does not work around the block. Marking over the options of scans already saved, unmarking and copying the list still work.
fonte.ligaVarredura: Options from the scan saved on {data}.
fonte.ligaSemVarredura: This collection has no saved scan: there are no options to mark. Choices already made stay on the list, and you can take them off.
fonte.cardmarketTexto: {comPreco} of {cartas} candidate cards priced; {aBuscar} to look up. Each price holds for {dias} days. Looking up prices is on the buy options screen, still in v1.
fonte.semPrecoNenhum: With no price yet, the choice is yours, card by card: the shortcut only marks a priced card.

celula.livres: {total, plural, =1 {1 free copy of yours fits} other {# free copies of yours fit}}

barra.cartas: {total, plural, =0 {Nothing on the list} =1 {1 card on the list} other {# cards on the list}}

atalho.botao: Mark the best of each slot…
atalho.titulo: Mark the best of each slot
atalho.descricao: In every slot with no choice yet, the first card by the criterion below — only a priced card. Check it: nothing is marked before your click.
atalho.vazio: No slot to mark right now.
atalho.rotuloLista: {total, plural, =1 {The card that goes in} other {The # cards that go in}}

fora.jaTemEscolha: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot already has a choice and stays as it is} other {# slots already have a choice and stay as they are}}
fora.semPreco: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot with no price} other {# slots with no price}}: mark by hand
fora.semOpcao: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot with no option} other {# slots with no option}}
fora.pendentes: {total, plural, =1 {1 slot still saving} other {# slots still saving}}

atalho.feito: {total, plural, =1 {1 card went} other {# cards went}} on the list.

opcoes.nenhumaNaLista: Nothing from this slot on the list.
opcoes.limparTitulo: Take the {total} cards of this slot off the list?
opcoes.limparDescricao: Each one leaves the buy list. You can mark them again later.
opcoes.sumiu: This slot is no longer empty.
opcoes.vazioLigaSemVarredura: With no saved scan, there is no Liga option to mark. New lookups are unavailable.
opcoes.vazioPokedex: No card of this species in the catalog within the cap.
opcoes.vazioSet: No option for this card: not in the catalog, or hidden by the filters.
opcoes.soSai: A choice from an old scan: it can only come off the list.

preco.semPrecoNoCardmarket: no price at Cardmarket (looked up on {data})
preco.ligaEm: lowest price in the scan of {data}

lista.descricao: {total, plural, =0 {Nothing on the list} =1 {1 card} other {# cards}} · {valor}
lista.comoColar: Paste it into their Buy by List. Under “Adicionar Detalhes”, Quality: <forte>NM</forte>. Grouping by store is done by Liga, under “Otimizar minha Lista de Compras”.
lista.limitePorAba: Their Buy by List takes up to {limite} cards per search: paste one tab at a time.
lista.abaResumo: In this tab: {total, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} · {valor}.
lista.multiplas: More than one card for the same slot:
lista.semPrecoCardmarket: {total, plural, =1 {1 card} other {# cards}} with no Cardmarket value: on the list, not in the total.
lista.semPrecoLiga: {total, plural, =1 {1 card} other {# cards}} with no known price: they stay on the list with last time's price, or none.
lista.guardadas: {total} already added, off the list: they come back if the copy leaves the slot.
lista.listaGuardada: The list is kept: it survives a new scan and shrinks on its own as you add the cards.
lista.listaGuardadaCardmarket: The list is kept, and it shrinks on its own as you add the cards.
lista.totalEhReferencia: The {valor} add up the Cardmarket reference value converted at PTAX: close to Liga's lowest price, not a budget.
lista.totalEhPiso: The {valor} is the lowest price of each card in any condition — a floor for checking, not a budget in NM.
lista.copiadoAviso: {total, plural, =1 {1 card copied} other {# cards copied}}. Paste it into Liga's Buy by List.
lista.erroCopiar: Could not copy on its own — select the list's text and copy it by hand.

recusa.parcial: Part of the marking did not go in: the slot or the card changed (another tab, a filled slot). The list was read again.
recusa.pedido: The marking was refused: this slot's options changed. The list was read again.
recusa.servidor: Could not save the marking. The list was read again.
recusa.rede: No connection to the server: the marking was not saved.

geral.resumo: {vagas, plural, =1 {1 empty slot} other {# empty slots}} across {colecoes, plural, =1 {1 collection} other {# collections}}.
geral.nadaFalta: Every Pokédex and set collection is complete (or none has been created yet).
geral.copiasSuas: {total, plural, =1 {1 copy of yours} other {# copies of yours}}
